sessionTitle: Modernize intelligent apps and agents with .NET that scale as you grow

announcements.name: Agent observability in App Service
announcements.shortDescription: A new capability surfacing agent counts, call volume, token usage, and error rates over the last 30 days, with drill-through into Application Insights logs
announcements.longDescription: Azure App Service provides agent observability that surfaces intelligence about the agents running on your app, as long as the agent is added on the app and Application Insights is configured. It shows aggregate data such as the total number of agents (e.g. five agents in the last 30 days), call volume (52 calls), token usage over the last 30 days, and error rate. To dive deeper into an individual agent, you click "Logs" which takes you into Application Insights. You reach this experience the same way as the MCP server view—via "AI", "MCP servers", and then the "Agents" tab.

announcements.name: Secure RDP access via Azure Bastion
announcements.shortDescription: For the first time in Azure App Service, instances can be reached through Azure Bastion for troubleshooting with familiar tools like Event Viewer, Registry Editor, and IIS Manager
announcements.longDescription: For the first time ever within Azure App Service, you can now remote desktop directly to your instances using Azure Bastion. It uses a secure protocol throughout while giving full access to instances so you can use familiar tools such as Event Viewer, Registry Editor (Registry viewer), and IIS Manager for troubleshooting and investigation. All changes made during these sessions are temporary and must be backed up by changes to your installation script, because when the platform performs maintenance or replaces instances, those customizations need to be reapplied.
